notes: Lase and strike at any time

Targets of interest found by intel ops are marked on the map once you zoom well into a city (not at theater zoom): enemy fighters, technicals and mortar teams, armor during the invasion, strongholds, and reported safe havens with their confidence. Zoom closer for labels. The same targets show in the 3D and drone views
The laser designator in the 3D view works at any point in the war, not only after major combat. During the invasion, rounds landing on a lased enemy formation wear down the division holding that city
Strike aircraft in range can now drop a laser-guided bomb on the lased spot, alongside artillery and mortars
